main.description: DRAFT in the temp namespace; may change without notice. A projection of a seam:CrossingRecord whose canonical copy lives on the emitting party's own substrate. Published publicly only when the crossing itself was public; private crossings publish only an org.governedcrossing.temp.commitment. Crossing records are intentionally non-repudiable (every record carries the emitter's inline signature), a deliberate difference from permissioned-space deniability. They carry digests and references of what crossed, never the crossed content. Value lists are open; a record conforms only when it uses the registered values of the seam:CrossingRecord vocabulary. See CONFORMANCE.md.

recordId.description: Substrate-independent identifier of the canonical record; not the AT-URI of this projection.

emittedBy.description: Emitting party; also the `$sig.repository` value for every signature on this record.

provenanceStatusBasis.description: Required when provenanceStatus is not asserted.

chainReference.description: Immediately upstream record. For crossing-completion: the crossing-intent record.

lineageAnchorType.description: Required when chainReference is present. witness-signed and timestamp-signed are locked pending infrastructure; countersignatures do not unlock them.

boundType.description: Exposure claim. Ordered by admissible claim strength: exposure-unbounded < exposure-upper-bound < confirmation < attestation. The value must match the architecture's actual enforcement; overclaiming is inadmissible.

evidenceDecay.description: ISO 8601 date after which the record's claims require re-verification.

salt.description: Random salt. Required on any record for which a commitment is published, so a low-entropy record cannot be confirmed by guessing.

signatures.description: Attestation Specification v1.0 signatures array. A conformant crossing record carries the emitter's inline signature (role emitter). On private crossings countersignatures are inline only; remote strongRef countersignatures only on public crossings. A strongRef to the emitter's own commitment is permitted.
